The resulting images can be used as stickers with other apps, such as "PhotoLayers" to make a photomontage, collage, and composite photos.


- - - Features - - -
"Star" mode
・Detects image edges to erase easily & accurately.
"Auto" mode
・Erases similar pixels automatically.

It's very important to make a picture's background transparent accurately when you want to superimpose photos and make good composite photos.
By using this app, you can do it better.
